recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, desaturated photograph of a man standing on the porch of a white, weathered house under an overcast sky, featuring a two-tiered typographic layout in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The man's vertical posture aligns with the porch columns.
The diagonal roofline creates a strong geometric division in the upper half.
The earthy brown text color echoes the natural tones of the landscape and the man's vest.
The low-angle perspective makes the subject appear grounded and significant against the house.
coreInvariants: Muted, desaturated color palette with a slight film grain.
Strong architectural lines from the porch and roof.
Natural, diffused lighting with no harsh shadows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned slightly left of center, scaled to occupy the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white porch columns and the man's light-colored vest serve as primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject, follows the vertical column up to the roofline, and moves right to the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the large, flat white surface of the house's upper siding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and muted grey (house and sky) establish a neutral backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep greens and browns (foliage and dirt) provide a dark base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre/Burnt Sienna (typography and vest trim) provides warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with a compressed dynamic range, leaning towards a vintage film aesthetic.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, blocky strokes with minimal kerning.
Secondary text uses a thin, handwritten-style monolinear stroke.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight letter spacing in the display font to create a solid block of color.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed on the flat negative space of the house siding

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a heavy, industrial sans-serif and a light, personal script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky feel of the display text.
Captures the casual, handwritten feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of a man in a beige vest and jeans standing on a weathered white porch of a rural house. The sky is overcast and the colors are desaturated with a film-like grain. The upper right of the image should be a flat white house wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of heavy, burnt-sienna sans-serif text in the upper right, right-aligned. Below it, add a single line of thin, charcoal-colored handwritten script text.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette muted and earthy?
Is there a clear contrast between the two font styles?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of burnt sienna for text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the upper right

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible against the house siding.
Grain texture is consistent across the image.
The color of the text complements the vest and foliage.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle rural portrait with a desaturated film grade and a right-aligned, high-contrast typographic lockup in the negative space.
